Configured ESP_RTOS setting does not match with the command line
  Command line: none
  Configured: FreeRTOS
Make sure variables are set before target configuration file is included,
otherwise they will not be processed correctly!
For example, correct order of parameters on command line is:
`./openocd -s ./tcl -c "set ESP_RTOS hwthread" -f board/esp32s3-builtin.cfg`
